definitions.gloss: high praise; enthusiastic commendation; rave review
definitions.explanation: Extremely strong praise or admiration for someone or something. Stronger than ordinary praise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{批評家|ひひょうか}→批評家：19430_hihyouka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{激賞|げきしょう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It received rave reviews from critics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{激賞|げきしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The director highly praised the newcomer's performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧、⟦{文壇|ぶんだん}→文壇：22666_bundan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{激賞|げきしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}び→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧、⟦{一躍|いちやく}→一躍：11183_ichiyaku⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧になった。
examples.english: When this novel was published, it received enthusiastic praise from the literary world and became famous overnight.

notes:
Composed of {激|げき} (intense, violent) + ⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧ (praise, admiration). A formal word that conveys praise beyond the ordinary — not just approval, but intense enthusiasm. Commonly used in reviews of artistic works, performances, and achievements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {激賞|げきしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to praise highly
- {激賞|げきしょう}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ — to receive high praise
- {激賞|げきしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びる→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧ — to be showered with praise
- {激賞|げきしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{値|あたい}する→値する：25545_ataisuru⟧ — to be worthy of high praise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絶賛|ぜっさん}→絶賛：13840_zessan⟧ — highest praise, acclaim; very close synonym, perhaps even stronger
- ⟦{賞賛|しょうさん}→賞賛：14277_shousan⟧ — praise, commendation; more moderate and general
- ⟦{称賛|しょうさん}→称賛：21287_shousan⟧ — praise, admiration; synonym of ⟦{賞賛|しょうさん}→賞賛：14277_shousan⟧ with different kanji
